sentences.en: Everyone asks me what it's like to be colour-blind.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在问我色盲是什么样的体验。

sentences.en: I'm colour-blind because my grandfather was as well.
sentences.zh: 我是色盲，因为我祖父也是。

sentences.en: Some people are colour-blind: they are unable to distinguish between certain colours.
sentences.zh: 有些人是色盲：他们无法分辨某些颜色的区别。
